prose: On TBPN, Vinod Khosla laid out his prediction for the two moats of personal AI. First, trust: 'I believe the moat will be trust in a company that develops trust with consumers. And that's where Meta has a huge disadvantage.' Second, completion - a tool that actually gets the job done: 'Consumers will be loyal to products that get their shit done... If you can get all my stuff done, I'll be loyal to you.'
highlights: Khosla's two moats for personal AI: trust and completion.
Trust: 'a company you can trust with your data' - where Meta has 'a huge disadvantage'.
Completion: consumers stay loyal to tools that get everything done.
